newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM deal to boost M-Serla in boards.
newsitem.headline: UPM deal to boost M-Serla in boards.

text.p: Finnish forestry group Metsa-Serla Oy said on Tuesday its purchase of UPM-Kymmene's Simpele paperboard mill will make it Europe's second largest producer of folding boxboard.
"We will now reach a good position in Europe," Jorma Vaajoki, Metsa-Serla CEO told a news conference, indicating a slide showing Metsa-Serla in second position after Sweden's Stora.
According to the slide, Metsa-Serla's folded boxboard capacity would rise to 520,000 tonnes against Stora's 800,000 tonnes per year.
Metsa-Serla said in a statement the Simpele coated folding board machine's capacity was 140,000 tonnes per year, 90 percent of which was exported.

It also acquired the Simpele paper mill, which produces one-side coated specialities used for food wrappings, self-adhesive laminates and board laminates with a capacity of 50,000 tonnes per year, and a carton plant with 10,000 tonne capacity.
